dry_run.description: Enables dry run mode for the request call.

gap_auto_fill_scheduler_id.description: Gap auto fill scheduler ID used to determine gap fill status for rules

gap_fill_statuses.description: Gap fill statuses to filter rules with gaps by status (used together with gaps_range_*).

gaps_range_end.description: Gaps range end, valid only when query is provided

gaps_range_start.description: Gaps range start, valid only when query is provided

ids.description:
Array of rule `id`s to which a bulk action will be applied. Do not use rule's `rule_id` here.
Only valid when query property is undefined.

include_exceptions.description: Whether to copy exceptions from the original rule

include_expired_exceptions.description: Whether to copy expired exceptions from the original rule

duplicate.description: Duplicate object that describes applying an update action.

end_date.description: End date of the manual rule run

start_date.description: Start date of the manual rule run

run.description: Object that describes applying a manual rule run action.

end_date.description: End date of the manual gap fill

start_date.description: Start date of the manual gap fill

fill_gaps.description: Object that describes applying a manual gap fill action for the specified time range.

edit.description: Array of objects containing the edit operations
